constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: equivalent release-then-use sequences on the same resource role; equivalent lifecycle transitions across wrappers or helper functions; equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths.

constraints.title: Encode the patch-added barrier

constraints.title: Track resource identity across lifetime edges

constraints.title: Do not key on local identifier names

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence

constraints.title: No placeholder helper logic
